rules: Route rows are loaded from the exact-head CAR not_measured routes.
Each route receives an authenticated and unauthenticated loopback HTTP request; the digest route also checks its grant literal and a non-granted key.
Seven code-unit rows cite every directly mapped controller route pair, with the binding table in the plan.
Response bodies and credentials are not retained; status, bounded error code, response byte count and SHA-256 are recorded.
Mutations are confined to synthetic rows in the disposable PostgreSQL database.
